articles.title: Crypto IPOs could create massive $1 trillion market amid tokenization wave, Jefferies says
articles.snippet: The Wall Street investment bank expects a wave of crypto and blockchain public listings over the next two years as institutional investors shift their focus from speculative trading to real-world financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Solana DEX Orca launches new marketplace for tokenized real-world assets
articles.snippet: The launch comes as crypto companies increasingly focus on tokenizing traditional financial assets, a market many in the industry see as a major growth opportunity.

articles.title: BTC Prague 2026: Europe’s leading Bitcoin conference expands its cultural reach
articles.snippet: BTC Prague, Europe’s premier Bitcoin conference, returns to the PVA Expo Prague on June 11-13, 2026.

articles.title: Spot HYPE ETFs absorb 1% of market cap in first 10 trading days: Kairos
articles.snippet: Spot HYPE ETFs absorbed 1.04% of Hyperliquid’s market cap in 10 trading days, beating Bitcoin and Ether ETF debuts.

articles.title: Falcon Finance, SoFi unveil stablecoin products tied to banking infrastructure
articles.snippet: While Falcon’s new fUSD is built for institutional trading and collateral workflows, SoFiUSD targets consumer banking users through SoFi’s app.
